review_note: PBS NewsHour reported on September 18, 2003 that the Governor of Delaware had declared a state of emergency for Hurricane Isabel; the exact signing date was not found.

WHYY reported on February 10, 2010 that Governor Markell declared a statewide state of emergency once again, effective at midnight, for the second February 2010 blizzard. The declaration for the first storm (February 5 and 6) was not found.
